intro: Convert square feet (ft²) to square meters (m²) accurately for international real estate listings, architectural floor plans, tile orders, and commercial leases. Because 1 international foot equals exactly 0.3048 meters, 1 square foot equals 0.09290304 square meters (or square metres)—multiply sq ft by 0.09290304, or divide by 10.76391. Explore room, apartment, and commercial areas from 1 ft² to 10,000 ft² in the reference table below.
alsoWrittenAs: sq ft to sq m, sqr ft to sq m, ft² to m², sq. ft. to sq. m., square feet to square metres

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Linear Feet vs. Square Feet & Rounding Drift on Commercial Leases
items: Square feet measures 2D area, not linear length: first multiply length in feet by width in feet (ft² = L × W), then multiply by 0.3048² = 0.09290304. Using the linear factor 0.3048 instead of 0.09290304 overstates square meters by 3.28×.

Estimating square meters by dividing square feet by 10 instead of 10.76391 introduces a 7.6% error—turning a 5,000 ft² commercial space from 464.52 m² into 500 m². Always compute with 0.09290304 and round only the final result.

faqs.question: How many square meters are in 1 square foot?
faqs.answer: 1 square foot equals exactly 0.09290304 square meters (0.3048 m × 0.3048 m). Conversely, 1 square meter equals 10.76391 square feet.

faqs.question: What is 484 sq ft in square meters?
faqs.answer: 484 square feet equals 44.96507 square meters (484 × 0.09290304), or about 44.97 m².

faqs.question: How do I convert square feet to square meters?
faqs.answer: Multiply the area in square feet by 0.09290304, or divide by 10.76391. For example, 1,000 ft² × 0.09290304 = 92.903 m².

faqs.question: How do you calculate square feet from feet?
faqs.answer: Multiply the length in feet by the width in feet (ft² = L × W) to get area in square feet—for instance, a 10 ft × 10 ft room is 100 ft² (9.2903 m²). A single linear foot measurement cannot convert directly to square feet without a second dimension.
